    • Landing Type: Pacific Ocean splashdown.
    • Location: West of San Diego, California.
    • Mission Status: Completed 10-day moon flyby mission. 
    Future missions, such as Artemis III, are planned to land on the surface of the Moon near the lunar South Pole.
